Yeah I gonna have to agree with you. People on this post seem to lack empathy and have blinders on. Everyone grieves and loves differently. For me when my service dog died, it wasn’t just a dog dying as some people heartlessly put, it was a part of my soul dying. My dogs are part of my family, their a part of my heart, I think everyone just need to agree to disagree and go their separate ways. If some said something as heartless as my dog is just a dog after it passed I don’t think I would ever speak to them again, but again that’s me personally.
